Foundation’s management team includes industry experts, entrepreneurs and innovators with unmatched experience in the development, marketing and commercialization of prescription and non-prescription medicines. Our organization is financed by two established private equity funds, both with a successful history in the OTC marketplace and a solid commitment to building a diverse portfolio of brands under the Foundation banner.
